guide.intro: Voice App processes audio on your phone — local presets for quick tweaks, cloud AI for real voice character conversion.
guide.step1: Load an audio file ({{formats}}) from your device, or record directly with the microphone. You can preview or remove it anytime.
guide.step2: Pick an effect tier: Basic or Advanced (on device) for quick tweaks, or AI Effects (cloud) for real voice character conversion.
guide.step3: Tap Convert and wait until processing finishes. Preview the result and download the WAV file.
guide.step4: Save your favourite mix as a custom effect. Built-in effects stay read-only.

faq.q1Title: When does my audio go to the internet?
faq.q1Answer:
Basic and Advanced Effects run entirely on your device — your audio is not uploaded.

AI Effects use cloud voice conversion. When you convert with an AI effect (or a combined effect that includes AI), your audio clip is sent over the internet for processing. The result is downloaded and saved on your device.
faq.q2Answer: You can load: {{formats}}. The generated output is saved as WAV.
faq.q3Title: Why is there a duration limit?
faq.q3Answer: Free plan: max {{freeMaxDuration}} per file or recording (1 AI credit). Premium: up to {{premiumMaxDuration}}. Longer clips are trimmed automatically on import or record.
faq.q4Title: Where is the downloaded file saved?
faq.q4Answer: On Android it goes to Downloads/VoiceApp. On iOS it is saved to the VoiceApp folder in the Files app.
faq.q5Title: Why is my file prepared after load or record?
faq.q5Answer: After import or recording, VoiceApp may trim clips that exceed your plan length limit and copy them into the app’s local storage. You may see a short “Preparing your audio” step — nothing is uploaded to the cloud.
faq.q6Title: What are Basic, Advanced and AI effect tiers?
faq.q6Answer:
Effects are grouped into three tiers, from fastest to most advanced:

• Basic Effects — quick voice presets (pitch, tempo, echo, reverb and more). Processed on your device. Best for fast tweaks.
• Advanced Effects — studio-grade filter chains with precise pitch shifting and EQ. Also on your device — more natural than basic presets, but still DSP-based.
• AI Effects — real AI voice conversion into character voices (e.g. Narrator Female, Narrator Male, Legionary). Not just pitch shift — your speech is transformed in the cloud. Internet required; without it AI options stay disabled.

You can also combine two built-in effects in “Combine effects” — the first is applied to your audio, then the second is layered on top. Higher tiers generally need more CPU or network time.
faq.q7Answer:
It depends on clip length (free: up to {{freeMaxDuration}}; premium: up to {{premiumMaxDuration}}; your plan now: {{planMaxDuration}}), the effect tier, and your device or network.

• Basic Effects — usually a few seconds.
• Advanced Effects — typically longer than basic.
• AI Effects — cloud conversion; time depends on connection speed.

A progress overlay shows the current stage and elapsed time. Keep the app open and do not lock the screen until conversion finishes.
faq.q8Title: When can I use voice effects legally?
faq.q8Answer:
Use Voice App only on audio you own or have explicit permission to edit — for example your own recordings, licensed material you are allowed to transform, or voice work where everyone involved gave consent.

Appropriate uses include creative projects, voice acting, parody where you have the rights, and anonymizing your own voice.

Do not use effects to impersonate real people without consent, commit fraud, harass others, or violate copyright, privacy laws, or platform rules. AI voice conversion does not grant you rights to someone else’s voice or content.

You are responsible for how you publish or share exported files.
faq.q9Title: What does the final effect depend on?
faq.q9Answer:
The result is shaped by several factors:

• Source audio — background noise, room echo, and distance from the mic. A clear, close recording usually sounds better.
• Your voice — natural pitch and timbre; the same preset can sound different on a deep vs. high voice.
• Chosen effect — preset or tier (Basic / Advanced / AI), plus slider tweaks (pitch, tempo, echo, reverb, bass) when available.
• Combined effects — in “Combine effects”, order matters: the first effect processes your clip, the second is applied to that result.
• AI effects — cloud voice conversion; quality depends on the chosen voice, your source clip, and network conditions.
• Device / network — Basic and Advanced run on-device (CPU); AI needs a stable connection for upload and download.
faq.q10Answer:
Credits apply only to AI effects (cloud voice conversion) — on-device Basic and Advanced effects do not use them.

For AI conversion, credits are deducted when processing starts (before your audio is sent to the cloud), by started minutes: 1 credit = 1 started minute.

We cannot refund if you cancel, close the app, lock the screen, or lose internet after processing has started — the cloud service may already have billed the job. Keep a stable connection and leave the app open until the AI conversion finishes.

1 credit = 1 started minute of AI. Every started minute is charged separately (1–60 s = 1 credit, 61–120 s = 2 credits, and so on).

Premium is a monthly Google Play subscription: each month your credit pack resets to the full amount. Unused credits from the previous period expire and do not roll over. Manage or cancel in Google Play → Subscriptions.
